topic: Shared dashboard invite loops back to email entry
environment: Recipients outside the org behind an email security gateway
symptom_pattern: External recipients of an invite-only shared dashboard click the access link, enter their email, receive a verification email, click it, and land back on the email-entry page in a loop.
root_cause: The recipients' email security gateway rewrites or pre-scans links, consuming the one-time access link before the human clicks it.
resolution_path: Confirm sharing config and recipient list
Have the recipient inspect the raw link URL for a rewriting domain
Ask their IT to exempt the sharing domain from URL rewriting, then retry with the newest email in a normal window
info_needed: the raw URL in the email

qa_pairs.tse_question: When you right-click and copy the link from the email, what domain does it start with?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: It starts with something like safelinks.protection.outlook.com.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Do the emails arrive at all?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Yes, every time, within a minute.

customer_style.tone: account manager relaying a client complaint, non-technical
